user_priority: Fewer search decisions or candidate evaluations to reach the same result. Wall-clock speed is not a solving-efficiency claim. Count factor evaluations separately; UI, calibration, transfer and delivery features are supporting work.

entries.title: Competing inequivalent plaintext-family controls
entries.acceptance: Positive control has multiple distinct feasible families before scoring; full bank outcomes reported.

entries.title: Full-bank repeated-null calibration
entries.acceptance: Each null reruns identical frozen selection; complete/censored counts and empirical exceedances explicit.

entries.title: Incremental exact CPU window scoring
entries.acceptance: Same exact page ranking and candidate count, fewer ngram factor evaluations on sparse controls.

entries.title: Coordinated feasible-family guidance
entries.acceptance: Known interaction trap solved under fewer candidate evaluations than single-coordinate baseline; fixed held controls compare both work and failures.

entries.title: Admissible joint route/key pruning
entries.acceptance: Same exhaustive distinct-plaintext top-k; fewer candidate leaves on declared controls; ties and pruning-vs-count distinctions retained.

entries.title: Capped elimination upper bounds
entries.acceptance: Upper bound >= exhaustive residual optimum for every tested partial assignment; fewer proof nodes where stronger; caps preserve fallback.

entries.title: Certified device-side survivor filtering
entries.acceptance: Same integer-certified survivors/ties and exact ranking; reduced explicit interval payload transfer, not fewer search candidates.

entries.title: Optional measured backend selection
entries.acceptance: Bounded comparative sample, exact agreement, cache and overhead visible; hardware convenience, not fewer solving steps.

entries.title: Bounded sculpture-grid path parameters
entries.acceptance: Parameter aliases deduplicated before fitting; bounded bijections and independent encryption replay; explicit unknown method assumptions.

entries.title: Checkpoint more exact commands
entries.acceptance: Interrupted/restarted frontier matches uninterrupted ranking, counts and completeness; checkpoints atomic and compatible.

entries.title: Durable drafts and personal presets
entries.acceptance: Refresh restores drafts without starting computation; invalid payloads rejected.

entries.title: Paginated tagged archived run history
entries.acceptance: Thousands of summaries paginate without copying large candidate/results; archived records remain reversible.

entries.title: Diagnosed records and verified read-only recovery
entries.acceptance: Malformed/unsupported records reported; bounded hashed backups restore separate inert evidence; no imported frontier executes.

entries.title: Clean-package CI and verified release publication
entries.acceptance: Clean source package tested on Windows/Linux; actual CUDA evidence separately required whenclaimed; published release/tag/hash/gearashi attribution verified.

non_claims: No probability of authenticity inferred from null controls
